intro: My abstract paintings are a physical release of my dreams and emotions. With colour and various techniques put to canvas, each painting and composition of colours are a fingerprint of what has already been let go
about_text: Carla Gusek creates exploratory abstract paintings that reflect her inner psyche while inviting viewers to connect with their own emotions.
purchase_text: Interested in an artwork? Get in touch to ask about availability, pricing and shipping.
description: Explore the abstract paintings of Toronto artist Carla Gusek. Browse her portfolio and enquire about available artwork.
